title: feat(studio): open the icon picker in a roomy modal
body:
## Summary

The inline icon popover was cramped for browsing ~2000 Lucide icons. The picker now opens in a centered **modal** (Dialog): wider layout, a large search box, an 8-column grid showing up to 120 results, a "none" clear cell, and a "showing the first N of M — type to narrow" hint. Selecting writes the icon name and closes the modal; out-of-catalog values stay reachable.

## Verification
Verified live on the App editor: clicking the Icon field opens the modal ("Choose an icon", search, 8-col grid, "Showing the first 120 of 1964…"); searching "rocket" narrows to the match; selecting it writes the value and closes the modal. Full metadata-admin test suite (274) passes, including the existing IconPickerWidget tests.
